## workflow issues

List a view's issues, as the Issues pane lists them

### Synopsis

List the issues of one of jira.views — the first when --view names none, or
the issues assigned to you when none is configured — one a line: the key, the
summary and the status. A view is scoped to you unless its query names the
assignee, as the interfaces scope it, and the forge's issues join the first
view when issues.forge is on. Only the first page of 50 is read: a longer
list is noted on stderr, and --json carries its total. --json prints the web
API's page of issues.

```
workflow issues [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  workflow issues --view Sprint
  workflow issues --json | jq -r '.issues[].key'   # the keys alone
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help          help for issues
  -j, --json          print the page of issues as JSON
      --view string   the view to list, by its name in jira.views; the first when not given
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -n, --dry-run    hold back every write to Jira, the forge, the messaging service, Taskwarrior, git and files, and say what it would have done
      --log FILE   append a one-line outline of each request (method, path, status, duration) to FILE, for a bug report
```
